page.overview:
What is The Agony?

Afton's Amalgamation|latest=Fazbear Frights 7: The Cliffs (Stitchwraith Stingers)|date=20XXs|weight=Atleast 1,430 lbs (Presumably)|voice=Undocumented (None)}}

is an amalgamation of Andrew's infected objects. It's possessed by William Afton. It appeared in the epilogues in Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird and Fazbear Frights 7: The Cliffs.

The Agony is a vaguely man-shaped structure of trash primarily made from everything Andrew infected and the remaining junk and debris in the factory. Standing at nearly fifteen feet tall, its body is formed with moving animatronic body parts, joined in a haywire way. Heads are used as joints, arms as legs, and legs as arms. A torso forms from the hips, chest, and belly of three animatronics but their parts are put in the wrong places. Hands are inserted at random all over the structure. Wires and gears are woven through all the misplaced pieces, creating a labyrinthine circulatory system connecting hinges to gears and screws and nails to eyes, noses, and mouths. It has a neck made from shins and feet with mouths. The Agony’s head is made of animatronic fingers, toes, wires, and hinges, and resembles William Afton’s face. Its eyes are two gaping black holes made of metal sockets and spark plugs. The Agony's mouth is formed from long pistons, and its cheekbones are composed of large gears and bolts. Its face is held together with bits of pointed metal and rusted pipes. The Agony has two rabbit ears, one made of three-quarters of a metal hand and the other with a metal jaw. It has a hand composed of a foot with sharp metal toes and hip joint, and its feet are composed of hands, jaws, and joints. There’s a kneecap with an eye on it where a shoulder should have been. While the hybrid lacks the remains of the Stitchwraith endoskeleton, having ejected it from its own body, it contains the limbs and circuitry of at least four animatronics in a disorganized fashion. It's implied many other animatronics are inside, but the four animatronics that are confirmed and named to comprise the Agony's parts are Fetch, Ella, Foxy, and the Plushtrap Chaser. Part of it is made from Eleanor’s battered, rusting, long-necked, and vaguely female-shaped endoskeleton.

As the Agony pursues Larson, it contains to add parts to its body. A rat skeleton gets attached to an animatronic elbow acting as a chin, and a bird's foot is affixed to part of a motor acting as an eyebrow. It then absorbs a forklift into its body.
